nodes.title: Lilac and Gooseberries (prologue: tutorial, loot the crystal skull, Gwent with Aldert, buy cards from Elsa)
nodes.note: Manual. Play Aldert (the scholar) and buy from Elsa on the way; Aldert is hanged later in Velen.

nodes.title: The Beast of White Orchard (griffin)
nodes.note: Reporting the griffin is safe. The point of no return is the later talk with Vesemir at the inn.

nodes.title: On Death's Bed
nodes.note: Fails when the prologue ends (talking to Vesemir).

nodes.title: Precious Cargo
nodes.note: Cutoff is presumed (the wiki is blank): do it before the Vesemir talk.

nodes.title: A Frying Pan, Spick and Span
nodes.note: Cutoff is presumed (the wiki is blank): do it before the Vesemir talk.

nodes.title: Viper School gear: both sword diagrams (silver: Kolgrim crypt, steel: castle ruins chest)
nodes.note: No source says they are lost when you leave, but your route collects them here.

nodes.title: Places of Power and the rest of the White Orchard clean-up
nodes.note: Unverified whether a Place of Power here is missable.

nodes.title: The Incident at White Orchard (talk to Vesemir at the inn)
nodes.note: MAKE A MANUAL SAVE FIRST. This talk ends the prologue and fails the White Orchard side quests.

nodes.title: Contract: Devil by the Well
nodes.note: NOT lost when White Orchard ends. It fails at On Thin Ice, so it can wait.

nodes.title: The Nilfgaardian Connection (gate for all of Velen)
Hunting a Witch
nodes.note: Journal file has no readable entries, so detection is weak: tick it if it looks wrong.

nodes.title: Wandering in the Dark
nodes.note: Accept and finish Magic Lamp INSIDE the elven ruins before you leave.

nodes.title: Magic Lamp
nodes.note: Must be finished inside the ruins; skipping it also blocks the Place of Power there.

nodes.title: Ciri's Story: The King of the Wolves
An Invitation from Keira Metz
nodes.note: Only needs Wandering in the Dark (Magic Lamp is recommended first).

nodes.title: Lynch Mob (Hangman's Alley)
nodes.note: Do it BEFORE A Favor for a Friend starts (the end of Towerful of Mice).

nodes.title: A Towerful of Mice
nodes.note: Fyke Isle. Finish Lynch Mob before you return to Keira.

nodes.title: A Favor for a Friend
nodes.note: Starts after the Towerful of Mice. Do not refuse to play along at dinner.

nodes.title: For the Advancement of Learning (send Keira to Kaer Morhen)
nodes.note: On Fyke Isle: 'What's with the notes?' > 'Radovid never forgets' > 'It's suicide' > the Kaer Morhen option. Do NOT demand the notes first.

nodes.title: Forefathers' Eve
nodes.note: Optional; only after Towerful of Mice. No journal file found.

nodes.title: Family Matters (Bloody Baron line)
nodes.note: Cannot be finished until Ladies of the Wood is done. The final Baron conversation is the last chance to play him at Gwent.

nodes.title: The Whispering Hillock
nodes.note: A sub-quest of Ladies of the Wood. Consult the Downwarren ealdorman BEFORE freeing the spirit, or Return to Crookback Bog changes.

nodes.title: Beat the Baron at Gwent
nodes.note: Last chance is the final Family Matters conversation. After that the card is in his office.

nodes.title: Return to Crookback Bog
nodes.note: If you freed the spirit: pick the doll with the violet hollyhock bloom or Anna dies.

nodes.title: Ciri's Story: Out of the Shadows
nodes.note: Triggered by the final Baron conversation.

nodes.title: Hazardous Goods
nodes.note: Do it before Ghosts of the Past.

nodes.title: The Fall of the House of Reardon
nodes.note: Always available.

nodes.title: Ghosts of the Past (only if Letho is alive in your world state)
nodes.note: Only exists if Letho is alive in your world state (set it under My game). Do not stray from Letho or he leaves.

nodes.title: Keira sent to Kaer Morhen (your choice at the end of her chain)
nodes.note: Needed for Brothers In Arms: Velen. Excludes the late quest A Final Kindness.

nodes.title: Pyres of Novigrad
nodes.note: Entry quest: unlocks High Stakes and the Nobleman Statuette.

nodes.title: Novigrad Dreaming (let the godling Sarah stay)
Gwent: Playing Innkeeps (Stjepan, crossroads innkeeper, Olivier)
files: cginnkeepers#Win unique card from Stjepan the innkeeper
cginnkeepers#Win unique card from crossroads innkeeper
nodes.note: Olivier can die in Now or Never.

nodes.title: Broken Flowers (win BOTH Rosa duels; play Zoltan at Gwent)
nodes.note: Mapped by elimination (its journal file has no entries).

nodes.title: Fencing Lessons
nodes.note: Right after Broken Flowers.

nodes.title: Get Junior
nodes.note: Visit Cleaver first (The Gangs of Novigrad) before meeting the Redanian contact.

nodes.title: The Gangs of Novigrad
nodes.note: Talk to Cleaver before you clear both the arena and the casino yourself.

nodes.title: A Favor for Radovid
nodes.note: Never triggers if you leave Junior's compound without talking to Radovid's soldiers.

nodes.title: A Walk on the Waterfront
nodes.note: No journal entry. Do it before the witch-hunter outpost part of Count Reuven's Treasure.

nodes.title: Count Reuven's Treasure
nodes.note: Ask Menge about Dijkstra's treasure.

nodes.title: A Poet Under Pressure
nodes.note: Starts Cabaret and A Dangerous Game. Also unlocks Blood and Wine.

nodes.title: A Matter of Life and Death (Triss)
nodes.note: Win all 3 Vegelbud Gwent matches before the party ends.

nodes.title: Win the 3 Vegelbud Gwent matches (3 unique cards)
nodes.note: Temporary opponents: only chance, inside A Matter of Life and Death.

nodes.title: Carnal Sins
nodes.note: Pauses the Vegelbud race and postpones the ball; do the Vegelbud party first.

nodes.title: A Dangerous Game (take the three cards; loot the jade figurine)
nodes.note: Loot the jade figurine in Caesar's cupboard (the only chance for The Soldier Statuette).

nodes.title: Redania's Most Wanted (at least get the polished crystal in Philippa's hideout)
nodes.note: Do it before Now or Never so Triss can examine the crystal.

nodes.title: An Eye for an Eye (keep Ves alive)
nodes.note: Ves is needed to recruit Roche.

nodes.title: The Nobleman Statuette
nodes.note: Give it to Triss BEFORE Now or Never.

nodes.title: The Soldier Statuette
nodes.note: Give it to Triss BEFORE Now or Never.

nodes.title: Now or Never (Triss: rescue/romance)
nodes.note: Triss leaves Novigrad afterwards. Do the statuettes, the crystal and Olivier's Gwent first.

nodes.title: A Deadly Plot
nodes.note: Starts when Now or Never ends.

nodes.title: Gwent: beat Dijkstra
nodes.note: Unreachable from the start of Final Preparations.

nodes.title: Gwent: beat Thaler at the Seven Cats Inn
nodes.note: Deadline is Reason of State / On Thin Ice.

nodes.title: High Stakes (win every match; you get the leader cards and 4,500 crowns)
nodes.note: Scaled to level 26. No cards-or-coins choice.

nodes.title: The King is Dead - Long Live the King
nodes.note: Unlocks Possession, Lord of Undvik, Cave of Dreams, Phantom of Eldberg.

nodes.title: The Calm Before the Storm
nodes.note: Do it before the final Baron conversation in Velen (it fails A Mysterious Passenger).

nodes.title: The Last Wish
nodes.note: Do it as soon as it is offered. Fails when you retrieve Uma in Ugly Baby.

nodes.title: Flesh for Sale (Trottheim)
nodes.note: Locks when you talk to Lambert at the Seven Cats Inn in Following the Thread.

nodes.title: Following the Thread
nodes.note: Can start in Novigrad at L11; pause before the Seven Cats Inn talk until Flesh for Sale is done.

nodes.title: Contract: The Phantom of Eldberg
nodes.note: Must be done before King's Gambit.

nodes.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
nodes.note: Locks once King's Gambit starts.

nodes.title: The Cave of Dreams
nodes.note: Locks once King's Gambit starts.

nodes.title: An Unpaid Debt
nodes.note: No journal file found.

nodes.title: Possession
nodes.note: Finish after the Cave of Dreams and Stranger in a Strange Land.

nodes.title: King's Gambit
nodes.note: Starts when Possession and Lord of Undvik are both done.

nodes.title: Gwent: Skellige Style (Mousesack, Crach, Dagobert, Sjusta, Madman Lugos)
files: cgskellige#Win unique card from Sjusta the Tailor
cgskellige#Win unique card from Lugos the Mad
nodes.note: Lugos is lost when the ship sails in Battle Preparations, Crach at the On Thin Ice battle.

nodes.title: Ugly Baby (collecting Uma at Crow's Perch fails The Last Wish and Following the Thread)
nodes.note: Start it only when Velen, Novigrad and Skellige are in order. Mapped at medium confidence.

nodes.title: Keep quests: Disturbance, To Bait a Forktail, The Final Trial, No Place Like Home, Va Fail Elaine
Berengar's Blade (talk to Vesemir first)
nodes.note: Fails at the council in the Battle of Kaer Morhen.

nodes.title: Brothers In Arms: Velen (needs Keira sent to Kaer Morhen)
Brothers In Arms: Novigrad (ask Zoltan only after A Dangerous Game)
Gwent: Old Pals (Roche, Lambert; Zoltan)
files: cgoldfriends#Win unique card from Lambert|cgoldfriends#When occasion presents itself win unique card from Lambert
nodes.note: Roche and Thaler are Novigrad players; Eskel has no card of his own.

nodes.title: PRE-ISLE CHECK and named save
nodes.note: Everything with the Isle of Mists as its cutoff must be done. Check Keira, Baron, Triss, Dandelion, Zoltan, Roche/Dijkstra, succession, Letho, Gwent.

nodes.title: The Isle of Mists (boat trip to Undvik + final confirm)
nodes.note: Point of no return for 20+ quests. q402ciri starts earlier, when Uma's curse lifts.

nodes.title: Blood on the Battlefield: choose the snowball fight ('Think I know what might lift your spirits')
Same quest: do NOT go to the emperor first. Choose Velen
Bald Mountain
nodes.note: No journal file identified.

nodes.title: Final Preparations (Ciri meets the Lodge alone)
nodes.note: Do Payback, Blindingly Obvious, The Great Escape. The statuettes fail at the Lodge talk.

nodes.title: Final Preparations: let Ciri meet the Lodge alone ('You'll do fine on your own')
Blindingly Obvious (diplomatic option: 'I need her', then 'Tell you what the emperor's after...')
nodes.note: Creates Reason of State.

nodes.title: It Takes Three to Tango (only if both Triss and Yennefer are romanced)
nodes.note: Tick to skip if it does not apply.

nodes.title: A Final Kindness (only if Keira was NOT sent to Kaer Morhen)
nodes.note: Does not exist if you sent Keira to Kaer Morhen. Tick to skip.

nodes.title: Reason of State (before telling Avallac'h you are ready)
nodes.note: Also finish Warehouse of Woe and Thaler Gwent. Save here.

nodes.title: Child of the Elder Blood: let her wreck Avallac'h's lab ('Go for it')
Skjall's Grave: go with her ('Yeah. I'll go with you')
On Thin Ice (point of no return: fails Reason of State, Thaler, Crach, Devil by the Well)
nodes.note: Do not talk to Avallac'h by the boat until these are done.

nodes.title: Evil's Soft First Touches (loot Garin manor first; accept Rose on a Red Field)
nodes.note: Seven Cats Inn notice board.

nodes.title: Dead Man's Party (do the wedding activities)
A Midnight Clear (before leaving the wedding)
nodes.note: Fails if you leave the wedding area without doing it.

nodes.title: Open Sesame! (buy all four Viper armor diagrams from Countess Mignole; Hilbert Gwent)
nodes.note: One-time chance for the diagrams. Do the three sub-quests.

nodes.title: Open Sesame sub-quests: Witcher Seasonings, Breaking and Entering, The Safecracker
Avid Collector
nodes.note: Lost when Open Sesame! ends.

nodes.title: Visit Shani, then Professor Shakeslock (Oxenfurt) before the Temple of Lilvani
nodes.note: Skip Shakeslock and O'Dimm just takes Olgierd. Shani's Gwent card: win it or find it in her clinic upstairs.

nodes.title: Whatsoever a Man Soweth... (SAVE first; help Olgierd, solve the riddle)
Envoys, Wineboys (needs A Poet Under Pressure from Novigrad)
nodes.note: Delay accepting until you are ready.

nodes.title: The Warble of a Smitten Knight (win the tournament; finish BEFORE Capture the Castle)
nodes.note: Fails when you meet Damien in Capture the Castle.

nodes.title: Amidst the Mill's Grist
nodes.note: Closes once Where Children Toil finishes.

nodes.title: Where Children Toil, Toys Waste Away
Capture the Castle (point of no return for side quests; finish Warble and open side quests first)
nodes.note: No manual saves from its start.

nodes.title: The Night of Long Fangs (SAVE before the wardrobe book: take Syanna to Dettlaff, not the Unseen Elder)
nodes.note: The path choice is final once you interact with the book.

nodes.title: Beyond Hill and Dale (get Syanna's ribbon; read the first 2 playroom journal entries; listen to her story; investigate the 5th victim)
nodes.note: Ribbon: Little Flint Girl, 500 crowns or beat her at Gwent. Without it Syanna dies at Tesham Mutna.

nodes.title: Duck, Duck, Goosed!
nodes.note: Fails when Beyond Hill and Dale finishes.

nodes.title: Tesham Mutna
nodes.note: SAVE before the Dettlaff fight.

nodes.title: Pomp and Strange Circumstance (visit Syanna first; "Cause she turned her back on you, forgot about you" then "Ever thought to forgive her?")
Be It Ever So Humble...
nodes.note: Also needs Something Ends, Something Begins.

nodes.title: ALT SAVE: What Lies Unseen / Burlap is the New Stripe / The Perks of Being a Jailbird (excludes the both-sisters-live path)
nodes.note: Needs a separate save.

E_VESEMIR.src: wiki: Lilac and Gooseberries, The Incident at White Orchard

E_FAVOR.name: Starting A Favor for a Friend (the end of A Towerful of Mice)

E_BARON_ANNA.name: The final Family Matters conversation with the Baron
E_BARON_ANNA.src: wiki: Family Matters; fails A Mysterious Passenger if The Calm Before the Storm is not done

E_REDANIAN.name: Meeting Roche's Redanian contact in Get Junior

E_REUVEN.name: The witch-hunter outpost part of Count Reuven's Treasure
E_REUVEN.src: wiki: A Walk on the Waterfront

E_MATTER_END.name: The Vegelbud party ends (A Matter of Life and Death finishes)
E_MATTER_END.src: wiki: A Matter of Life and Death

E_NOW.name: Finishing Now or Never (Triss leaves Novigrad)

E_LODGE.name: The Lodge talk in Final Preparations

E_BIA_ZOLTAN.name: Asking Zoltan for help in Brothers In Arms: Novigrad

E_LAMBERT.name: Talking to Lambert at the Seven Cats Inn (Following the Thread)

E_UMA.name: Ugly Baby: retrieving Uma at Crow's Perch
E_UMA.src: wiki: The Last Wish, Following the Thread (fire detection approximate)

E_ISLE.name: The Isle of Mists (boat trip to Undvik and confirm)

E_COUNCIL.name: The council at the Battle of Kaer Morhen

E_BATTLEPREP.name: The ship sails in Battle Preparations

E_THINICE.name: On Thin Ice: talking to Avallac'h by the boat

E_SOWETH.name: Whatsoever a Man Soweth... without meeting Shakeslock

E_WHERE.name: Where Children Toil, Toys Waste Away finishes

E_CAPTURE.name: Meeting Damien in Capture the Castle (side-content cutoff)
E_CAPTURE.src: wiki: The Warble of a Smitten Knight

prefs.why: Recommended (wiki): Triss leaves Novigrad after Now or Never, so do the statuettes, the crystal, Olivier's Gwent and the Vegelbud matches first.

flags.label: Letho is alive in my world state
flags.note: Needed for Ghosts of the Past. It comes from your Witcher 2 import or the default world state. Answer No and that quest stops counting.

flags.label: I sent Keira to Kaer Morhen
flags.note: Decides between Brothers In Arms: Velen (sent) and A Final Kindness (not sent).

flags.label: I am romancing Triss
flags.note: It Takes Three to Tango only exists if you romance both Triss and Yennefer.

flags.label: I am romancing Yennefer
flags.note: It Takes Three to Tango only exists if you romance both Triss and Yennefer.
